new_destinations.name: Kangaroo Island
new_destinations.coordinates_source: Wikipedia Kingscote article point (island's main town and ferry-linked hub); centred on Kingscote so Cape Borda, Remarkable Rocks and Cape Willoughby all lie within 75% of the span

name_evidence.source: Wikivoyage 'Kangaroo Island' page and the Tourism Kangaroo Island board (tourkangarooisland.com.au)
name_evidence.wording: Wikivoyage has a Kangaroo Island destination page covering Penneshaw, Kingscote, American River and Parndana; the board organises destinations around the island (West End, Penneshaw and Dudley Peninsula).

new_destinations.description_notes: Mention Parndana (central base) and Cygnet River in the description; Flinders Chase National Park is a spot, not a separate destination (see decision).
new_destinations.decision: One island destination, not Flinders Chase NP as its own: the island is the name travellers use, the park (west end) is one cluster of 20+ spots in a 150 km island, and a separate park destination would overlap the island's span (no overlapping destinations). Rank 2: Kangaroo Island is a state headline and a guidebook top-billing island, but not world-famous (rank 1).
